mapper.select: select avg(score) from score_record where user_id=#{scoreRecord.userId} and type=#{scoreRecord.type} and clazz_id=#{scoreRecord.clazzId}
SELECT user_id,GROUP_CONCAT(`type`,":",score)AS scores FROM score_record where score_record.type like concat('t_','%') GROUP BY user_id

SELECT s.user_id, s.clazz_id, SUM(IF(s.type = 'exam', s.sum_score, 0)) AS 't_exam', SUM(IF(s.type = 'kpoint_study', s.sum_score, 0)) AS 't_kpoint_study', SUM(IF(s.type = 'shixun', s.sum_score, 0)) AS 't_shixun' FROM (SELECT clazz_id,user_id,type,sum(score) as sum_score FROM score_record where clazz_id=#{scoreRecord.clazzId} GROUP BY user_id,type ) s GROUP BY s.user_id

select students.*,(select course_name from edu_course where edu_course.id=2286) as clazz_name, (select SUM(score_record.score)/#{examTotal} from score_record where score_record.clazz_id=#{clazzId} and score_record.course_id=#{courseId} and score_record.user_id=students.id and score_record.type='exam') as exam_score, (select SUM(score_record.score)/#{kpointTotal} from score_record where score_record.clazz_id=#{clazzId} and score_record.course_id=#{courseId} and score_record.user_id=students.id and score_record.type='kpoint_study') as kpoint_study_score, (select SUM(score_record.score)/#{shixunTotal} from score_record where score_record.clazz_id=#{clazzId} and score_record.course_id=#{courseId} and score_record.user_id=students.id and score_record.type='shixun') as shixun_score from (select edu_student.*,(select MAX(edu_trxorder_detail.auth_time) from edu_trxorder_detail where edu_trxorder_detail.course_id=#{clazzId} and edu_trxorder_detail.user_id=edu_student.id) as course_auth_time from edu_student where edu_student.is_deleted = 0) as students where students.course_auth_time is not null
